topic: Find where a classifier model, Jev hosted or local Deem 0.8B, cuts the main AI's context and manual review work in this repository.
label: grok

focus: grok-01: The served 0.8B against the documented 9B, from their published numbers
noveltyJustification: Claim table separates release 0.8B, release 9B, and Qwen3-1.7B development checkpoints, and no calibration file names deem-0.8-v1.
answeredQuestions: Which published numbers are shared by the 0.8B and the 9B? None. Which calibration file belongs to deem-0.8-v1? None.

ruledOut.approach: Serve deem-9b-v1 on the JevBench 65.8 figure
ruledOut.reason: No shared judgment with the 0.8B card, and parent D3 already chose the 0.8B on RAM

focus: grok-02: Wire compatibility, field by field: Deem /v1/systemone against both jev packages
noveltyJustification: Field-level request and exit table for the Python jev-cli against parse_question; jevctl kept as a separate package.
answeredQuestions: Does a thin custom-endpoint wrapper reach Deem for choice and score? No. Does run pass a Deem-shaped body? Yes, from code.

ruledOut.reason: Python jev-cli sends criteria and reads noul/score keys Deem does not return
jevctl schema requires criteria and its exit 2 is a different taxonomy; SDK body is not in the repo

focus: grok-03: Outside patterns for context reduction with a local classifier
noveltyJustification: Schema source is 2225 bytes versus zero for a hook, and compact.ts:285 fail-opens a missing answer to keep.
answeredQuestions: MCP is the wrong shape; row 44 does not flip on latency alone
ruledOut: per-request history filter because the call is local

focus: grok-04: Which dropped rows a local model revives
noveltyJustification: Classed all 72 drop rows. None of the latency rows flip on the warm p95.
answeredQuestions: No latency/egress drop flips on warm p95 alone
ruledOut: reviving live hooks from the warm p95

noveltyJustification: SKILL.md claims 7 frameworks; the registry holds 5 ids.
answeredQuestions: A choice can cover the five registry ids only; CLEAR is not a label set
ruledOut: choice over the seven prose names

noveltyJustification: Five design intents are already keyword-scored. No hub routing accuracy exists.
answeredQuestions: A choice does not replace the design checklists or the keyword router

focus: grok-07: One interface for a hosted and a local classifier
noveltyJustification: Calibration is invisible to the client. deem-ctl has no pin. Route (c) is later.
answeredQuestions: Bodies differ so the hub names two transports; a client cannot see calibration
ruledOut: preferring a backend because it needs no rewrite

focus: grok-08: Tare flip gate against R1 flip rate
noveltyJustification: Three different flip statistics. Conditioned gate would loosen R1 at low accuracy.
answeredQuestions: Tare conditioned flip must not replace R1 0.10
ruledOut: copying Tare ECE or negation probes into a keep rule

focus: grok-09: Vendor claims versus local numbers
noveltyJustification: JevBench row is 9B vendor. Registry reader is the benchmark sweeper. Judgment arms wait on labels.
answeredQuestions: Survivors do not inherit card accuracy or LOCAL p50 as quality
ruledOut: using 96.3 percent or JevBench 65.8 as this machines result

focus: grok-10: If only one classifier phase ships
noveltyJustification: No new classifier phase. D2 tension named. swe-01 timing not adopted.
answeredQuestions: Zero-call census first; no judgment arm until a pinned flip
ruledOut: shipping the Deem client as the one phase
